# Retract path to see if blocks return to left
print("Retracting path...")
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    if not last_action_result.get('board_changed', False):
        print(f"  LEFT {i+1}: no more change")
        break

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
print("\n=== After retract ===")
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels'] == 16:
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        print(f"  {n['color']}: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

player = next((n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18), None)
if player:
    rows = [p[0] for p in player['boundary']]
    print(f"  Player: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}")

# Check for path
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] > 10:
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        print(f"  Path (w): rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
